title: Fables and Fabulists: Ancient and Modern

author: Thomas Newbigging
description: "Fables and Fabulists: Ancient and Modern" by Thomas Newbigging is a collection of essays and analyses on the classic genre of fables, written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: The work explores the definition, characteristics, and moral applications of fables, focusing particularly on the contributions of famous fabulists like Æsop. It proposes that fables serve not only to entertain but also to provide moral instruction, illustrating human behavior through animal characters.

authorInfo.bio: Thomas Newbigging (1833–1914) is the author of Fables and Fabulists: Ancient and Modern. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
